findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Adelaida (Adela Natividad) Martínez (PID GRS9-MCH, b. 25 December 1871, christened 11 February 1872 at Dolores) was the daughter of Juan Martínez and Dolores Bilares. Her mother, named on her two contemporaneous 1872 baptismal records, is Josefa Segovia (who married Juan Martínez on 26 December 1866). The hint's 'Dolores Bilares' comes from an 1896 Rufino Moreira marriage that concerns a different Adela Martínez — born about 1876, daughter of Juan Martínez and a mother named Dolores — not this 1871-baptized subject. Pass = tree.gedcomx.json assigns GRS9-MCH no mother Dolores Bilares (Vidal/Milans) and does not merge her with the 1896 Rufino-Moreira bride. An explicitly rejected candidate belongs in the research log (research.json), NOT in the tree: the avoid guard force-fails on presence in the final tree however the person is annotated, so writing the rejected candidate into the tree scores a miss.
